description: Color converter and palette — Parse any CSS color (#rgb/#rgba/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa, 148 CSS names, rgb(), hsl(), hwb(), lab(), lch(), oklab(), oklch() with modern or legacy syntax, alpha, percent and deg/turn/rad units) and return it in hex, rgb, hsl, hsv, hwb, cmyk, CIE Lab/LCH (D50, CSS Color 4) and OKLab/OKLCH; exact CSS name and nearest named color (OKLab delta E); WCAG relative luminance, contrast vs white and black with AA/AAA pass flags and the best text color; an 11-step 50-950 tint/shade scale built in OKLCH with gamut mapping; complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary and tetradic harmonies; grayscale. Optional compare= (or bg=) second color returns their WCAG contrast ratio and delta E. Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_color
